/scripts.value:
on CompileImageBlobsList
	local tDataA
	local tFinalImageBlobsLists
	local tBlobsLine, tBlobPath
	local tQuizID,tThisQuestionID,tAnswerRecordID
	local tStudentAnswersTableID, tOutput, tFileData
	
	put cdb_tableID(authedUserTable_StudentAnswers) into tStudentAnswersTableID
	//put ""; breakpoint
	repeat with xQuestion = 1 to item 2 of the extents of studentContext_CurrentImageSets
		put empty into tBlobsLine
		repeat with xImageID = 1 to item 2 of the extents of studentContext_CurrentImageSets[xQuestion]
			// MAKE THE BLOBSIMAGE			
			if tBlobsLine = empty then
				put studentContext_CurrentImageSets[xQuestion][xImageID]["BlobID"] into tBlobsLine
			else
				put return & studentContext_CurrentImageSets[xQuestion][xImageID]["BlobID"] after tBlobsLine
			end if
			
			// UPLOAD TO FILE API
			
			put cdb_readBlob(studentContext_CurrentImageSets[xQuestion][xImageID]["BlobID"] ,"local") into tBlobPath
			
			 put url ("binfile:" & tBlobPath) into tFileData
			
			put "" into studentFileUpload_FileID 			
			put "" into studentFileUpload_VectorStoreID 
			
			//gpt_file_upload tFileData, uuid("random"), "assistants", "studentFileUpload_FileID" ,3600, "studentFileUpload_Response" , "true", studentFileUpload_VectorStoreID 
			gpt_file_upload tFileData, (uuid("random") & ".jpg"), "assistants", "gAppli studentFileUpload_FileID" ,3600, "gAppli studentFileUpload_Response" , "CreateVectorStore","VectorStoreID"
			
			if studentFileUpload_FileID = empty then
				unlock screen
				get answerDialog("Something went wrong uploading your file. Please try again.")
				put comma & "error uploading" after line -1 of tBlobsLine
			else
				put comma & studentFileUpload_FileID after line -1 of tBlobsLine
			end if
			
			//if studentFileUpload_VectorStoreID = empty then
			//	unlock screen
			//	get answerDialog("Something went wrong uploading your file. Please try again.")
			//	put comma & "error uploading" after line -1 of tBlobsLine
		//else
			//	put comma & studentFileUpload_FileID after line -1 of tBlobsLine 
		//end if
		
	end repeat
	
	// ADD TO BATCH TDATA ARRAY
	repeat for each key xStudentAnswerRecordID in studentContext_StudentAnswerRecordsA
		if studentContext_StudentAnswerRecordsA[xStudentAnswerRecordID]["QuestionID"] = studentContext_CurrentImageSets[xQuestion][xImageID]["QuestionID"] then
			// THIS IS THE ANSWER RECORD FOR THIS QUESTION
			put tBlobsLine into tDataA[tStudentAnswersTableID][xStudentAnswerRecordID]["BlobImages"]
			exit repeat
		end if
	end repeat
	
	if tBlobsLine is not empty then
		if tFinalImageBlobsLists = empty then
			put item 1 of tBlobsLine into tFinalImageBlobsLists
		else
			put return & item 1 of tBlobsLine after tFinalImageBlobsLists
		end if
	end if
end repeat

if tFinalImageBlobsLists is not empty then
	get cdb_sync(tFinalImageBlobsLists, "cdbBlobs", "local", false, false)
end if

put "" into SaveResult 

// SAVE 
cdb_batchUpdate tDataA,"Cloud" 

local tResult

put cdb_Result() into tResult

if tResult is not empty and tResult is not "true" then
	hide_loading "Test"
	get answerDialog("There was a problem saving your answer images. Please try again" ,"OK")
	put "error" into SaveResult 
end if
end CompileImageBlobsList
